role: Own whole material author decisions, not independent scientific acceptance

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Grundrechte in Fallbeispielen anwenden
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Grundrechte an aktuellen Fällen prüfen.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assess fundamental rights in current cases.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Grundrechte in Fallbeispielen anwenden
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Grundrechte in Fallbeispielen anwenden.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine Person betrachtet mit einer Lupe Fallmotive einer öffentlichen Rede und eines geschützten Briefes. Pfeile führen zu einem abstrakten Rechtsbuch mit Schild; ein Fragezeichen hält die Fallprüfung offen.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: M1 supplies the actual dated controversy; M2 supplies current norms and M3 supplies explicit model facts. Task 1 applies informational self-determination, interference and justification to W/N, including the stipulated equally effective narrower alternative, purpose, scope and duration.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s1 awards the concrete protection/interference/alternative/balancing performance, not an article label. Complete absence or consistently wrong case-based rights assessment cannot pass by other tasks. Meaningful incomplete application remains eligible for earned points.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: Model variants are explicitly hypothetical; the real hearing is not an enacted-law or new-judgment claim. The two current positive-profile cases are whole read assessment guidance, not a minimum exercise quota.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Grundrechte und Checks and Balances
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.titleEn: Fundamental rights and checks and balances
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Grundrechte und Gewaltenteilung in Bezug auf Verfassungswirklichkeit erläutern.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain fundamental rights and the separation of powers in relation to constitutional practice.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Grundrechte und Checks and Balances
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Grundrechte und Checks and Balances.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine junge Person mit Sprechblase und geschütztem Brief steht vor Parlament, Regierung und Gericht. Pfeile zwischen den drei Institutionen veranschaulichen gegenseitige Kontrolle.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Task 2 uses the fictional A/B implementation evidence to distinguish formally independent courts and remedies from actual reasoned review, enforceable correction and verified executive compliance; a ministry dictating the result and ignored orders defeat the formal guarantee.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s2 requires the actual implementation comparison. Merely naming parliament, government and court cannot replace constitutional practice. Entire absence of actual power control invokes the published performance boundary.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: No factual claim that these fictional A/B administrations depict present Germany; partial but specific implementation analysis remains creditable.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Gerechtigkeitskonzepte vergleichen
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Modelle zu Sozialpolitik und Staatsfinanzen diskutieren.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss models of social policy and public finance.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Gerechtigkeitskonzepte vergleichen
resourceLinks.altText: Drei Gedankenfelder zeigen Bedarf, Gleichbehandlung und Chancen. Vier Personen diskutieren um einen öffentlichen Haushaltsbeutel mit verschiedenen Ausgabensymbolen.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Task 2 compares equal shares, needs-based support and contribution-based support on the same hypothetical households and same monthly 600 budget, computes remaining burdens and explains conflicting justice criteria and access effects. Task 4 applies a defended criterion to the publicly financed reform.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s2 and s4 require an actual distinction between the given models. Numerical table completion without comparison does not replace the model discussion. The own 25-point model-free whole work is capped at 17; a reasoned but incomplete comparison earns partial points.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: The monthly household allocation is deliberately distinct from annual billions in the macro budget. No conversion between them or empirical universal fairness claim is assumed.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Rechtsstaatliche Prinzipien prüfen
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Gewaltenteilung, Rechtssicherheit und Kontrolle der Exekutive an Beispielen prüfen.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assess the separation of powers, legal certainty, and checks on the executive using examples.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Rechtsstaatliche Prinzipien prüfen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Rechtsstaatliche Prinzipien prüfen.
resourceLinks.altText: Drei Stationen zeigen parlamentarische Regeln, Verwaltung und gerichtliche Kontrolle. Eine junge Person präsentiert zwei symbolische Fallkarten zum Vergleich.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Task 3 explicitly tests legal certainty through published, foreseeable purpose, criteria and duration, alongside separation of powers and reconstructable independent executive review. W has internally changeable criteria and unreconstructable review; N has prescribed case-bound criteria and logged reasons.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s3 separates legal certainty from separation/control. The own otherwise strong 27-point whole submission completely omits legal certainty and is capped at 17; the genuinely incomplete 19-point whole submission includes specific foreseeability and review and passes.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: Logging is not alone legal certainty; analysis must address predictable and sufficiently clear rules. No all-details or perfect-answer requirement is added.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Verfassungs- und Rechtsstaatkonflikte
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.titleEn: Constitutional conflicts and the rule of law
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aktuelle Konfliktfälle hinsichtlich Grundrechten und Rechtsstaat diskutieren.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss current disputes involving fundamental rights and the rule of law.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Verfassungs- und Rechtsstaatkonflikte
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Verfassungs- und Rechtsstaatkonflikte.
resourceLinks.altText: Zwei junge Personen diskutieren zwischen einer friedlichen Demonstration und einem Sicherheitsmotiv mit Polizei und Schild. Eine Waage mit Versammlungs- und Schutzsymbol sowie ein Fragezeichen rahmen die Abwägung.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Task 4 evaluates the actual 21 September 2026 Bundestag hearing positions in their documented state as of 10 October 2026, links them to supplied right/security concerns and a counterargument, and distinguishes political debate from a constitutional-complaint process and an undecided judicial outcome.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s4 credits the dated current dispute, conditional legal route and truthful status. A purely timeless generic opinion, without the documented conflict, cannot bypass the full current-case contract.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: The earlier 16 February 2023 BVerfG decision concerns specified previous HE/HH powers; it is not a ruling on the 2026 bills. No final enactment or operating-system claim is made.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Staatsfinanzierung und Verschuldung
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Finanzierungsformen und Verschuldungsgrenzen diskutieren.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss forms of public financing and borrowing limits.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Staatsfinanzierung und Verschuldung
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Staatsfinanzierung und Verschuldung.
resourceLinks.altText: Steuern und Kredite führen als getrennte Finanzierungswege zum Staatshaushalt. Darunter stehen Bildung, Gesundheit und Verkehr; daneben erinnern Kalender und Münzen an spätere Zahlungsverpflichtungen und eine Frage an Verschuldungsgrenzen.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Tasks 1, 3 and 4 compare contribution/tax/subsidy/cuts/borrowing alternatives, distinguish annual insurance/federal flows and public debt stock, and apply the current regular national Article 115 rule to stipulated non-emergency, no-cycle, non-security-excess federal numbers: 0.35% of GDP 5000 = 17.5; proposed deficit 18 exceeds by 0.5.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: Points require genuine funding and stock/flow reasoning and application of a current debt limit, not a legal label. Entirely absent stock/flow distinction or wholly absent current-limit application cannot pass by other material points; isolated errors remain ordinary partial credit.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: The existing contract permits national OR European limits. National Article 115 suffices; no full 753 LK fiscal-rules competence or EU-rule gate is invented. Compliance does not establish sustainability, and recurrent care spending needs recurrent financing.

wholeCurrentDEENGoal.title: Ziele des Sozialstaats abwägen
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.titleEn: Weigh the objectives of the welfare state
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Zielkonflikte zwischen Effizienz und Gerechtigkeit in der Sozialpolitik analysieren.
wholeCurrentDEENGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can analyse trade-offs between efficiency and justice in social policy.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Ziele des Sozialstaats abwägen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Ziele des Sozialstaats abwägen.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine Waage stellt soziale Absicherung und Effizienzmotiven wie Tätigkeit und Produktion gegenüber. Zwei passende Puzzleteile über der Waage veranschaulichen mögliche Ergänzungen; mehrere Personen diskutieren die Abwägung.

sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.bodyDemand: Task 3 computes retained additional earnings 60 versus 105 from the stipulated withdrawal rules and explains a conditional work incentive and additional funding need. Task 4 contrasts justice/access and resource efficiency, including complementary care/employment effects under a staffing and quality constraint.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.rubric: s3 and s4 award a concrete behavioural/resource mechanism with conditions; a mere word efficiency or a fairness preference is insufficient. The own 26-point mechanism-free whole work is capped at 17. The 20-point incomplete work with one arithmetic error demonstrates a real mechanism and passes.
sevenIndividualPerformanceRepairs.variationBoundary: The dossier gives hypothetical model inputs and states behaviour is unknown. It never guarantees increased employment, measured productivity, cost savings or tax self-financing.

currentNormDecisionSecurity: Current GG Article 94(1) no. 4a and Article 94(4), not the former Article 93 numbering; Article 19(4), Article 20, Article 97 and BVerfGG 90 remedies/admissibility support conditional legal paths. The dated hearing is primary evidence of the dispute only. Full BVerfG HTML was not successfully freshly downloaded by this author; actually read official indexed passages and official WD3 pages 6–10 are truthfully documented.
currentNormDecisionCare: The current regular Article 115 0.35% federal rule and conditional exclusions are read from the actual official provision. The model explicitly contains no eligible security excess, cycle, special fund or emergency. Only exact C19 Article 115 propositions are reused; no C19 EU/753 whole-contract judgment is transferred.
existingSemanticKindBasis: Both are whole terminal assessments of several existing ordinary goals. They retain practiceAssessment, introduce no curricularAtomic and no additional memory-card obligation. The true applicabilityFromRequires flag follows mandatory reviewed whole performance contracts; it is applicability only and never standalone curricular source coverage. Foreign whole body/flag qualification remains required.
courseBoundary: Current GK/LK material tags and all seven ordinary contract tags remain exact. Actual HE security applicability and 13-country care intersection are compiler witnesses. Country/view access is a separate foreign scope check; these bodies do not claim a complete official GK course.
